title: PagePulse
description: A configurable, automated auditing service designed to keep Confluence spaces healthy, accurate, and up to date. It continuously monitors pages across specified spaces and tags, evaluates their last published or updated timestamp, and alerts teams when content becomes stale.

title: FootballPredictor
description: A small, experimental project that uses historical football (soccer) results to generate likely outcomes for upcoming matches. It analyses past games, learns simple patterns, and produces predictions such as likely scorelines or match outcomes (home win, draw, away win).

title: iq-bot
description: An AI-powered Q&A assistant that generates reliable responses to predefined, topic-specific questions. It gathers and structures source information, applies clear writing standards, and delivers consistent, easy-to-scan answers.

title: Static Portfolio Site
description: My portfolio site, built with vanilla JS, hash routing, JSON-driven content, accessible and performant.
